short.vo: Three balls left in the day. शुभमन गिल, on ninety-eight. Jacob Duffy bowls him through the gate. But day three was bigger than that. India started it two hundred and nine behind. They finished a hundred and eighteen ahead.

scene.sub: Gill b Duffy. But India led by 118.

short.vo: Three hundred and twenty-seven runs. Three wickets. Eighty-six overs.
And every session was faster. Eighty runs before lunch. A hundred and five to tea. A hundred and forty-two in the evening.
The morning was के एल राहुल's. A hundred off two hundred and seven balls, his first in New Zealand, and by Cricbuzz's count a Test hundred in every SENA country.

scene.name: RAHUL
scene.caption: Per Cricbuzz: a Test hundred in all four SENA countries.

short.vo: देवदत्त पडिक्कल added a hundred and sixty-five with him. Eighty, and then one ball from Kyle Jamieson that held its line. A hundred, missed by twenty.
Then the second new ball. Thirteen overs, fifty-six runs. गिल's fifty, a pull for six, put India in front. राहुल fell soon after, bowled by Nathan Smith for a hundred and thirty-six.

events.t: to tea: 56 runs in 13 overs, one wicket
Gill's fifty: a six, and India lead

short.vo: Then रिषभ पंत. Fifteen off thirty-seven balls, and then thirty-seven off eighteen. Two sixes in two balls off Duffy. Fifty-two off fifty-five.
गिल made ninety-eight, off a hundred and forty-six balls. Nine fours, two sixes.

scene.name: GILL
scene.caption: Pushed in front of the pad. The ball sneaked through.

short.vo: It is the fourth-highest score by an India captain in New Zealand. Only Azharuddin, twice, and Gavaskar have made more.

But it is his fourth dismissal in the nineties. Ninety-one, ninety-one, ninety, and now ninety-eight. The second India captain out in the nineties against New Zealand. The first was एम एस धोनी, for an identical ninety-eight.

items.d: v New Zealand · like Dhoni, 98, Nagpur 2010

short.vo: Still, all five of India's top five went past fifty. It has happened five times in Tests, says Cricbuzz.

head.sub: INDIA'S TOP FIVE · THE FIFTH TIME IN TESTS · PER CRICBUZZ

short.vo: New Zealand's bowlers paid. Jacob Duffy: twenty-nine overs, one wicket, a hundred and eighty-one runs. Fourteen no-balls in the innings, seven of them his.

head.sub: RUNS PER OVER · FULL INNINGS SO FAR

short.vo: So, day four. India lead by a hundred and eighteen, with six wickets in hand. How big a lead do they set? Comment one, under two hundred. Two, two hundred to three hundred. Three, more.

items.d: India bat New Zealand out of the game

short.vo: Subscribe, and we'll break down day four the same way.

India vs New Zealand, 1st Test day three: India 486 for 4, a lead of 118. KL Rahul's hundred, Devdutt Padikkal 80, Rishabh Pant's fifty, and Shubman Gill out for 98 off the third-last ball of the day. The records: Gill's fourth dismissal in the nineties, the fourth-highest score by an India captain in New Zealand. How big a lead do India set? Comment 1 under 200, 2 200 to 300, 3 more.
